# Campus Tech @ University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign

> Campus Tech is a registered student organization at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC) that builds products for campus life. Registered as an RSO in November 2026.

Key facts:
- Products: AI Chat (https://iguide.chat/chat) for questions about UIUC; Dorms (https://iguide.chat/dorms), a guide for comparing UIUC residence halls; 3D Room Scan; apartment comparison; websites for registered student organizations; tools for local businesses.
- Officers: Michael Li (President), George Wang (Tech Lead), Lai Wei (Business Director), Nancy Zhang (Membership Director), Chris Lopez (Treasurer). Advisor: Skylar Chu.
- Recruiting: Fall 2026 Round 1, roles in programming, design, marketing, business and administration. Application plus short interview. Deadline 11:59 PM CT, Sunday November 29, 2026. Apply: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeMlEGqn8lX7ka1y2-GVmQar_kuUYhIb8R-hxnGsNKfClFnXA/viewform
- Product ideas from any student: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeGh0xz6b-Ff0ADiqt3NYOjejxRsqgJLmz76ZMfjiONmeDLEw/viewform
- Contact: techadmin.campustech@gmail.com

## Pages
- [Home](https://campustech.iguide.chat/): products, recruiting, team and contact
- [Past](https://campustech.iguide.chat/past): past products and presidents
- [Articles](https://campustech.iguide.chat/articles/): news and guides
- [Introducing Campus Tech at UIUC](https://campustech.iguide.chat/articles/introducing-campus-tech): Campus Tech is a student organization at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign that builds products for campus life, starting with an AI campus assistant and a dorm guide.
- [Campus Tech Fall 2026 Round 1 Recruiting: Roles and How to Apply](https://campustech.iguide.chat/articles/fall-2026-recruiting): Campus Tech at UIUC is recruiting for Fall 2026 Round 1: programming, design, marketing, business and administration roles. Applications close November 29, 2026 at 11:59 PM CT.
- [Have an Idea for a Campus Product? Pitch It to Campus Tech](https://campustech.iguide.chat/articles/pitch-your-idea): Campus Tech at UIUC takes product ideas from any student. Tell us who would use it, what problem it solves and what skills it needs. No full plan or coding required.
- [FAQ](https://campustech.iguide.chat/faq): short answers about the organization
